summary: Louisville victim lost more than $1 million in a pig-butchering investment scam that began after clicking a pop-up advertisement for a free AI chatbot book. Scammers built trust, presented fraudulent investments and fake profits, and persuaded the victim to make at least 14 face-to-face handoffs of cash and physical gold, including additional payments for fake withdrawal penalties.
prevention: Never transfer cash, gold, or crypto for investments promoted by unsolicited online contacts / Never pay additional penalties or fees to unlock investment withdrawals
classification_warning: physical courier variant of pig-butchering investment scam
